This AI agent answers operations questions about 196,000 food deliveries from DoorDash’s publicly available data (early 2015). A language model reads each question and chooses a tool: for questions about past deliveries it writes and runs a SQL query; for questions about a new order it uses a delivery-time model I trained. It then explains the result in plain English.
